Class CriteriiUtilizator

java.lang.Object
SocialNetwork.domain.CriteriiUtilizator
public final class CriteriiUtilizator extends Object
Utility class providing static filtering criteria for Utilizator entities. Can be used with Repository.findAll(Predicate) and combined using Predicate.and(Predicate), Predicate.or(Predicate), Predicate.negate(), or Predicate.not(Predicate).
